meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把素材和脚本拼成有品牌风格的成片或混剪视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有素材和脚本,想做成一条完整的品牌片或混剪。
copy.tagline_en: Turn footage and a script into a finished branded video or montage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have footage and a script and need a finished reel or montage.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 通用流程创作或编辑自定义合成:先确认技能版本,读取 BRIEF.md 或项目状态,再规划分镜、编排动画与媒体、按检查点推进并渲染成片。
howto.when: 当没有专用工作流匹配,或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时进入;也用于较长或多场景的片子、品牌与宣传片、混剪等。全新创作会先经 hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 帮我做一个 30 秒的品牌短片,分三个场景
say.note: 会先规划分镜,再逐场景搭建

say.text: 把这段素材重新剪成快节奏的混剪
say.note: 复制同一视频源,按片段范围重排时间

say.text: 把 BRIEF.md 设成 companion,我们边聊边做
say.note: 以导演视角先给出完整方案供你删减

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors or edits custom HyperFrames compositions: it checks the skill version, reads BRIEF.md or project state, plans scenes, handles motion and media, and renders the piece through checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Use when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Covers longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, etc. Fresh creation routes through hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second brand film with three scenes
say_en.note: It plans the storyboard, then builds each scene

say_en.text: Recut this footage into a fast-paced montage
say_en.note: Duplicates the source clip and re-times the ranges

say_en.text: Set BRIEF.md to companion and let's co-create
say_en.note: It proposes a full treatment first for you to trim
